assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: main X-grade comparison photo for an internal laptop inspection application. Input image is a reference only for the grey Dell Latitude family, metal texture, clean white studio backdrop and elevated rear three-quarter composition. Generate a NEW single photorealistic product photograph, landscape 3:2. Show the ENTIRE closed grey-metal Dell laptop fully inside the frame, not cropped. Keep the lid intact. The BASE side wall immediately forward of the right rear hinge has a clearly OPEN MISSING SECTION roughly 5 cm long and 1.5 cm high, substantially longer than a USB-A port. This is a hole with an actual section of base chassis missing, dark hollow interior visible, realistic thin rigid fractured metal edges, not a dent, not the ordinary seam between lid and base, not an added port. Place an intact USB-A port farther along the same side to provide natural size context. Damage unmistakable even as a small grading image. All remaining laptop geometry and hinge attachments coherent and straight. Real coated rigid metal with fine grain, fresh silver fracture faces and hard edges, NOT clay, melted wax or soft crumpled foil. Neutral softbox lighting, white background, no UI, captions, rulers, arrows, hands or watermark.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: X-grade follow-up photographic inspection example. Real hard thin metal fracture edges, unwarped intact surrounding laptop, fine realistic metal grain.
